Failed minima reject the candidate before full validation/timing.
protocol.full_gate: All32 correctness and independent Native/ON/OFF paired timing with 3+11 observations. Native summed medians improve >=3%; ON and OFF sums may not regress >1%. Any per-row median or P90 regression >5% gets exactly one confirmation; a repeated same-metric excess rejects. Preserve all observations and prior rejected experiments; fresh unchanged five-way comparison required after acceptance.
protocol.validation: Focused GC/publication/string tests; every material success/failure path and reachable deterministic allocation index, both zero ledgers, heap budget precedence without allocator calls, exact boundary/slot growth/reuse/retirement, rooted and unrooted borrowed byte slices, aliased output, embedded NUL/empty/Unicode, GC errors and pending-state cleanup. Full ON/OFF CTest, all32 outputs, focused ASan/UBSan and x86 Rosetta, architecture/memory/docs/generated gates. LinuxLSan/fullTier1 remain explicit open gates.
protocol.host_gate: No builds/tests/profiles during acceptance timing; three quiet snapshots 10s apart, process monitoring every5s, reject known foreign compute >=40% CPU and monitor gaps >15s. Frozen control/compiler/native/runtime/source identities.
protocol.limits: Original arguments, outputs, algorithms and 64MiB heap; logical header/payload/slot byte charges unchanged. D055 budget-over-host precedence is corrected to the accepted normative contract, not weakened.
